name: ReadingView
title: ReadingView
summary: The chapter reader: a sticky bar with book and translation pickers, text size and listen, over a single serif column with verse numbers, section headings, highlights and footnotes.
whenToUse: Use for reading a whole chapter of Scripture on dot.bible language pages and in the dot.Bible app.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a single verse or a short quote; use VerseBlock.
Do not use for articles or long-form ISM stories; they use the normal page type.

anatomy.description: `.sx-reader` frame → `.sx-rbar` (sticky, 68px) → `.sx-col` (max `--measure-scripture`, about 70 characters). Text size control (opens from Aa): Set the chosen size on `.sx-body` through `--sx-text` (`style="--sx-text:22px"`).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the article: book, chapter and translation, for example "John 3, Berean Standard Bible".

props.name: lang
props.description: Language of the text (BCP 47). Set for non-English text.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction of the text. Use "rtl" for Arabic-script and Hebrew translations.

props.name: pickerLabel
props.description: Visible text of the book and chapter picker button in the bar, for example "John 3".

props.name: translationLabel
props.description: Translation abbreviation shown in the translation picker button, for example "BSB".

props.name: pickerOpen
props.description: The book picker is open (`aria-expanded`). Render a `BookPicker` next to the reader.

props.name: translationOpen
props.description: The translation picker is open (`aria-expanded`).

props.name: onPickerClick
props.description: Called when the book picker button is pressed.

props.name: onTranslationClick
props.description: Called when the translation button is pressed.

props.name: onListen
props.description: Called when the listen button is pressed; it opens the AudioPlayer mini player. The button is shown only when given.

props.name: textSize
props.description: Controlled text size in px.

props.name: defaultTextSize
props.description: Initial text size when uncontrolled.

props.name: onTextSizeChange
props.description: Called when a text size step is chosen.

props.name: theme
props.description: Reading theme, set as `data-theme` on the reader.

props.name: bookLabel
props.description: Label above the chapter title, for example "The Gospel of John".

props.name: chapterTitle
props.description: Chapter title (the single h1), for example "John 3".

props.name: sections
props.description: Chapter content as sections of verses.

props.name: footnotes
props.description: Footnotes referenced by verses, rendered below the text.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content placed at the end of the text column.

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names.

props.name: bookLabel
props.description: Book label above the title, e.g. "The Gospel of John".

props.name: chapterTitle
props.description: Chapter title, e.g. "John 3". Also the heading of the screen.

props.name: blocks
props.description: Chapter content: section headings and paragraphs of verses.

props.name: footnotes
props.description: Footnotes shown below the text.

props.name: lang
props.description: BCP-47 language of the text. Sets script line-height and direction. Defaults to the theme language.

props.name: pickerLabel
props.description: Text shown on the book/chapter picker button, e.g. "John 3". Defaults to `chapterTitle`.

props.name: translationLabel
props.description: Translation abbreviation shown on the translation button, e.g. "BSB".

props.name: onPressPicker
props.description: Opens the BookPicker.

props.name: onPressTranslation
props.description: Opens the translation list.

props.name: pickerOpen
props.description: The book picker is open (caret rotates, border turns blue).

props.name: translationOpen
props.description: The translation list is open.

props.name: textSize
props.description: Current text size. Uncontrolled starts at 19.

props.name: onTextSizeChange
props.description: Called when a text size is chosen.

props.name: onPressListen
props.description: Opens the audio player (the one Horizon Blue control in the bar). Hidden when omitted.

props.name: onPressFootnote
props.description: Called when a footnote marker is pressed.

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names; override for translation.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Render the chapter inside a ScrollView under a fixed bar. Set false to embed in your own scroller.

variantNotes: Picker buttons (`.sx-sel`): default, hover (`--gray-100`), open (`aria-expanded="true"`: Horizon Blue border, caret rotates 180°), focus ring.
Text size: four steps, 17 / 19 (default) / 22 / 25px. The selected step is white with a light shadow.
Highlight: `.sx-hl` peach wash (`--gradient-peach` 70%), wraps cleanly across lines.
Footnote: `.sx-fn` superscript letter in `--horizon-blue`, note in `.sx-fnote` below a `--gray-200` rule.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Body text `--font-serif`, line-height 1.7 at every size step. Never justify.
Column never exceeds `--measure-scripture`; center it with generous side padding (40px desktop).
Verse numbers `.sx-v`: sans 12px 600, `--horizon-blue-dim`, superscript. Never bold the verse text.
Section headings `.sx-sh` are sans 19px 600; chapter title `.sx-ch` is sans 40px 600.
The pickers open here, so they carry a caret ⌄ (the chevron SVG). The bar is sticky and translucent (`--blur-glass`).
The listen button `.sx-play-sm` is the one Horizon Blue control in the bar. It opens the AudioPlayer mini player.
do: Use for reading a whole chapter of Scripture on dot.bible language pages and in the dot.Bible app.
Body text `--font-serif`, line-height 1.7 at every size step. Never justify.
Column never exceeds `--measure-scripture`; center it with generous side padding (40px desktop).
Verse numbers `.sx-v`: sans 12px 600, `--horizon-blue-dim`, superscript. Never bold the verse text.
Section headings `.sx-sh` are sans 19px 600; chapter title `.sx-ch` is sans 40px 600.
The pickers open here, so they carry a caret ⌄ (the chevron SVG). The bar is sticky and translucent (`--blur-glass`).
The listen button `.sx-play-sm` is the one Horizon Blue control in the bar. It opens the AudioPlayer mini player.
dont: Do not use for a single verse or a short quote; use VerseBlock.
Do not use for articles or long-form ISM stories; they use the normal page type.
accessibility: Name the article with book, chapter and translation (`aria-label="John 3, Berean Standard Bible"`).
One `h1` per chapter; section headings are `h2`.
`.sx-sel` uses `aria-haspopup` (`dialog` for BookPicker, `listbox` for translations) and `aria-expanded`.
The translation button reads its full meaning: `aria-label="Translation: BSB"`.
Footnote markers are links with `aria-label="Footnote a"` pointing at the note's `id`.
Text size is a `radiogroup`; each step is a `radio` with `aria-checked`.
Set `lang` and `dir` on the reader for non-English and right-to-left text.
content: Use the translation's own section headings; do not invent them.
Book label in `.overline`: "The Gospel of John".
Footnotes: verse reference bold, then the note ("**3:3** Or *born from above*; also in verse 7").
